annotations.title: Recast a viral hook with your subject

description: RECAST A VIRAL HOOK with the brand's own subject (the egg rolling off the table becomes your product; your host does the viral move), then join it into your clip. voice/language: a new voice, or language lip-synced, for one person swapped in. hook: a public post link (TikTok, Reel, Facebook, X; one lookup; not YouTube, which cannot be downloaded) or a video file. Subject: creator (saved name or id), image (a product or person; a real person's photo records consent), or neither for the brand's first product photo. A DUO OR GROUP (2-4 people): subjects [{creator or image, position: 'left'|'right'|'center' or your own words, refs?, outfit?}], each bound to its place in the frame, keeping that performer's movement and timing on the original sound. LOCATION AND OUTFITS, same pass: location (a place photo or words) moves the scene; outfit (a photo or words) re-dresses the subject, subjects[].outfit each person; with no subject named nobody is swapped and only those change (useBrand:true also swaps in the brand product). Pictures are references (4 max; more in words). Person for person: Seedance 2.5 (720p) if the hook is our render or faceRoute is set, else Wan 3.0 (≤15s; Kling 4.0 Edit past). FULL LENGTH: past its one pass (30 s) the window is recast in passes, each continuing from the previous one's frame and crossfaded across the cut, under the original sound: one video up to 60 s, quoted as passes plus join. mode 'auto' is always 'swap' (a region edit: camera, set, light, timing, text and sound kept; a multi-shot hook goes shot by shot); 'motion' only if asked (your person moves in their photo's setting). swap: your own words for what changes. start/end pick the window (3 s minimum; default: a group or a location/outfit change takes the whole clip, one subject the first 10 s). PAID, QUOTED FIRST: no confirm returns the plan and credits; confirm:true once the user okays. Then get_job until done, and post_edit with videoUrl = the result and ops [{op:'join', clips:[{url: your clip}], bridge:{kind:'impact'}}].

confirm.description: true = render it (after the user okayed the quote)

creator.description: a saved creator's name or id (list_creators). NONE SAVED: cast a preset by exact name (list_creators), or pass image instead: a portrait of an AI person that generate_image painted from words (no reference photo) swaps in on every plan, nothing to save. A described lookalike of the user is fine on every plan; a photo of anyone is a real face (paid plan)

end.description: window end in seconds of the hook

faceRoute.description: 'face_lane' = the user's "I own the rights to this face" for a real person in the source clip (paid plans). Only on the user's say-so, never on your own.

hook.description: the viral hook: a post link or a video URL

image.description: a picture of the subject instead: a product or a person. A person generate_image painted from words with no reference photo counts as an AI face on every plan

language.description: the new voice speaks this language (e.g. 'Spanish'), mouth lip-synced to the new words; voice defaults to 'match'

location.description: move the scene: a photo URL of the place, or words ("a sunny beach at golden hour")

mode.description: auto (always a swap), swap (edit what you describe), or motion (move your person in their own photo's setting)

model.description: swap: omit for the default; a clip editor id (kling-4-edit, kling-o3-edit; hermoso_capabilities), or for one person swapped for another 'wan-3' (≤15 s) / 'minimax-h3-max-recast'

outfit.description: what the subject (or, with no subject, the main person in the hook) wears instead: an outfit photo URL or words

resolution.description: swap: the output tier, on an editor that prices by one (kling-4-edit 720p or 1080p); default the hook's own pixels

start.description: window start in seconds of the hook; minimum window is 3 seconds

subjects.description: a duo or group recast, 2-4 people, instead of creator/image

creator.description: a saved creator's name or id

image.description: or a picture of this person

outfit.description: what this person wears instead: an outfit photo URL or words; alone (no creator/image) it keeps this person and changes only the clothes

position.description: where they are in the hook: 'left', 'right', 'center', or your own words ('who raps first'); all or none

refs.description: up to 3 more views of the SAME person (a saved creator's pose plates ride automatically)

swap.description: what changes, in your own words

useBrand.description: false = no brand product photo; true with location/outfit and no subject = also swap in the brand product

voice.description: one person swapped in: a NEW voice for them instead of the original speaker's: 'match' (fits them), 'female'/'male', or Aria, Sarah, Charlotte, George, Brian, Charlie. Omit = keep the clip's voice. Never a cloned voice
